_comment: Minesweeper screenshot capture. 500-field no-guess CAMPAIGN (valid loadLevel indices 0-499, display level = idx+1; 6x6 0-9 ... 16x12 200-249, 18x14 250-309, 22x14 310-369, 24x16 370-429, 30x16 430-499). Every slot is a gameplay board at a distinct level and theme: window._msShot(idx,theme,frac,{hint,fit}) loads the level, taps its safe start tile, then plays real logical deductions (msDeduce - the same solver the gate uses) until ~frac of the safe tiles are open with proven mines flagged, applies Minesweeper's real board palette (window._MS_THEMES) + midnight chrome, optionally fits a big field on screen or shows an on-board hint highlight. Promo cards (event intro) are removed during capture so no slot carries an overlay. Phone ships 7, tablets 2 each.
